'''Big Devil''' was a member of the [[Grove Street Families]] until his death some time before [[1992]]. He is mentioned by gang leader [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]] at his mother [[Beverly Johnson]]'s funeral in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].
